name: Pad Lights
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Pad colour shows; VJ, LIGHTS and SAMPLES pad pages fire FLOW VJ, the lights desk and your own sounds.
description: SAMPLES page (Sample pads row, off by default): HOT CUE + SLIP LOOP, pads 1-4 play the 4 sounds of a Drum Roll bank on the USB (DRUM ROLLS/Bank N: kick, snare, clap, hihat files), pads 5-8 pick Bank 1-4; hits land on the next beat and play through that deck's channel. VJ + lights pads row: HOT CUE + BEAT JUMP = FLOW VJ Looks, HOT CUE + BEAT LOOP = lights desk. Any pad-mode button alone gives the pads back. Idle show, Beat pulse, Phrase countdown, FLOW lights: pad colour modes.
